title: Jira Is $8.15/Seat. Here's What Teams Build Instead.
summary: How teams are replacing Jira with custom AI-built project management tools — save $4,000-40,000/year and get exactly the workflow you need instead of Jira's.
body_markdown: A custom web app is mobile-responsive but won't have a native iOS/Android app unless you build one. For most engineering teams, a mobile-responsive web app is sufficient — only a minority use Jira's native mobile app regularly. If you need native mobile, Blink's backend API is accessible from any React Native app you build.
